name: plotune-nexus
description: Script-backed agent skills for offline automotive engineering workflows plus Plotune Nexus MCP hardware execution, artifacts, diagnostics, and safe device control.

interface.shortDescription: Script-backed automotive skills and Plotune Nexus MCP workflows
interface.longDescription: Plotune Nexus provides script-backed agent skills for offline automotive engineering work such as CAN/DBC trace decoding, UDS payload and sequence linting, ODX/PDX inspection, A2L/LAB and XCP planning, calibration diffs, AUTOSAR architecture reports, safety and cybersecurity workproducts, requirements traceability, evidence packs, and tool-stack planning, plus resource-first Plotune Nexus MCP workflows for bounded CAN, DDS, XCP, UDS, UART, artifacts, gateways, containers, test sequences, and n8n automation JSON.
defaultPrompt: Connect to my Nexus device and summarize its CAN, UART and DDS status.
Decode this CAN trace with my DBC file and flag anomalies.
Plan a UDS diagnostic session for my ECU and lint the request sequence.
